title: OpenArt conversion + attribution signal contract
description: The TARGET behaviour of OpenArt's existing tag stack (GTM-56CMP8K, Google tag gateway /4vu8/, Meta pixel + CAPI Gateway, TikTok/Reddit/LinkedIn/X/UET/OpenAI Ads). PASS means the behaviour is fixed; today's live site is expected to FAIL most checks. Every observation comes from requests that were failed locally and never delivered. Claim ids refer to research/00_claims_register.md (FINAL VERDICTS).
templates: {uid}, {email}, {transaction_id} and {invoice_id} resolve from the replay scenario's synthetic context (src/replay/scenarios.ts).

checks.title: Signup reaches Google Ads, with user data
checks.rationale: The app pushes `signup`; the Google Ads signup conversion (AW-11252321380/rVk2CJ7Ot8EZEOSYw_Up) listens for `new_user_signed_up`, which nothing emits (research/11 §0 claim 1). Fixed = the real signup push produces a Google Ads conversion carrying user-provided data (EC envelope or em). The check is pinned to the signup conversion label: any other conversion firing on signup does not count, and the user data must ride on that conversion (a labelled copy with em/eme, or ccm/form-data for the same account).

checks.title: LinkedIn purchase has a value and an event id
checks.rationale: Today LinkedIn conversion 29290225 carries only conversionId (research/11 §3.2). The Insight tag maps conversion_value->val and event_id->eventId on the wire.

checks.title: X sends exactly one purchase event with a deterministic id
checks.rationale: uwt.js sends the explicit tw-qwghh-13vj24 conversion AND an automatic gtm_purchase for every purchase (research/11 §6.1), each with a random per-hit event_id. Fixed = one purchase event whose conversion_id/order_id is the transaction id.

checks.title: TikTok signup event_id equals reg_<uid>
checks.rationale: TikTok CompleteRegistration fires with event_id "" (research/11 §3.1) while Meta and OpenAI already use reg_<uid>; a server-side twin can only deduplicate against reg_<uid>.

checks.title: business_subscription is consumed
checks.rationale: The app pushes business_subscription for business-tier first purchases but no tag listens; only a TikTok diagnostic beacon notices it (research/11 claim 3).

checks.title: No Google automatic form_start/form_submit events on generation
checks.rationale: The Google tag's automatic form events turn a prompt submission into form_start/form_submit remarketing hits (auto-noise) while no real generation/activation event reaches any ad platform.

checks.title: Exactly one page view per route change — Google Ads
checks.rationale: Suite soft navigations: Google/Reddit/LinkedIn/X send 0, Meta and UET up to 3 (research FINAL VERDICTS G15). Google is counted per destination seen on the hard load.

checks.title: Exactly one page view per route change — Meta
checks.rationale: Browser /tr and the CAPI Gateway copy share one eid and count once.

checks.title: Exactly one page view per route change — TikTok
checks.rationale: TikTok's HistoryObserver already sends one Pageview per soft navigation.

checks.title: Exactly one page view per route change — Reddit
checks.rationale: Base pixels fire only on gtm.js (hard loads); no History Change trigger (research/02 §2.3).

checks.title: Exactly one page view per route change — LinkedIn
checks.rationale: Base Insight tag fires on gtm.js only.

checks.title: Exactly one page view per route change — X
checks.rationale: X base pixel fires on gtm.js only; the t.co + analytics.twitter.com copies share one event_id and count once.

checks.title: Exactly one page view per route change — Microsoft UET
checks.rationale: enableAutoSpaTracking sends pageLoad spa=Y per history change, i.e. more than one per route when the app redirects.

checks.title: fbc present after a multi-hop journey
checks.rationale: Landing → second marketing page → app loses fbc in both /tr and the CAPI Gateway although the shim holds fbclid (research/01 §T1, T1f).

checks.title: fbc present after a return (typed) visit
checks.rationale: Landing, then a typed /home: no fbc anywhere (research/01 §T1, T1g).

checks.title: oppref preserved on marketing landings
checks.rationale: The OpenAI Ads SDK runs only on the app and reads only location.search; the Astro shim does not keep oppref, so ChatGPT-ads click refs are lost on marketing landings (research/01 T3a vs T3b).

checks.title: gbraid/wbraid persisted in oa_ad_clids
checks.rationale: The app's reader keeps only gclid/fbclid/msclkid/ttclid and rewrites oa_ad_clids, deleting a stored gbraid (research/01 T2c).

checks.title: In-app-browser handoff URL carries attribution or a token
checks.rationale: Option 2 of the 'Open page in your browser' overlay copies window.location.href, which after the usual landing → /home hop has no click ids, UTMs or token (research/01 §T11).

checks.title: Consent defaults set for EEA/UK/CH in consent mode
checks.rationale: Every Google hit carries gcd=13l3l3l3l1l1 (no default, no update, research/01 §T2). Each probe serves the live Google scripts with the visitor geo rewritten locally to an EEA / UK / CH region and decodes gcd on the attempted hits.

validity: A check is ERROR (never PASS/FAIL) when its source did not run as specified: a replay scenario that did not execute or threw, a tag that was not ready on the replay page, a journey step that failed, a journey that never reached an app page or deviated from params.stepPaths, a route change that was not a clean soft navigation, a consent probe whose geo could not be simulated. SKIP only appears for sources deliberately not requested (e.g. --no-replay).
